_note: The 20-second 'how it works' film under the hero. Four beats: she sits down with her phone, the real /create flow, her real finished site, and her showing it to a customer. The two AI beats are generated; the two middle beats are built in ffmpeg from the merchant's own screenshots and screen recording and are NEVER sent to a video model — a model that redraws every frame destroys UI text, and the whole point of those beats is that the text is real.

1-ai-open.title: She sits down with her phone after closing
1-ai-open.prompt: A Malaysian Malay woman wearing a soft dark tudung (hijab) in her small western-food kedai makan after closing time. The chairs are up on the tables behind her. She lowers herself onto a stool by the counter, tired but calm, and picks up her smartphone in one hand, looking down at it. The phone screen is dark and switched off — nothing on it is readable. Warm tungsten bulbs above the counter, deep shadow beyond, the shot framed with her just right of centre and the left third empty and dark.
